description.value: A family-run, year-round farm market on Clayburn Road in Abbotsford featuring a full-service butcher shop, in-season local produce, and farm-to-table products. They have an on-site cafe and a culinary team preparing ready-made meals — ideal for a touring cyclist looking to restock with quality local food. Part of the Fraser Valley Circle Farm Tour self-guided route.
